user_query: trass gmail with term mgm or shipbob or merchant or support last 1 month AND trass stories and trass gmail with term expandly from any time

intent.goal: Find emails with terms mgm/shipbob/merchant/support from last month AND find both stories and emails with term expandly

date_filter.description: last 1 month AND any time combined query

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender_name,
    COALESCE(g.sender_email, '') as sender_email,
    COALESCE(g.message_content, '') as message_content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND (
    (u.database_name = 'gmail' 
    AND g.email_date >= date('now', '-1 month')
    AND (
        g.subject LIKE '%mgm%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%mgm%'
        OR g.subject LIKE '%shipbob%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%shipbob%'
        OR g.subject LIKE '%merchant%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%merchant%'
        OR g.subject LIKE '%support%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%support%'
    ))
    OR
    (u.database_name IN ('gmail', 'stories')
    AND (
        u.title LIKE '%expandly%'
        OR COALESCE(g.subject, '') LIKE '%expandly%'
        OR COALESCE(g.message_content, '') LIKE '%expandly%'
    ))
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
